newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to re-auction Mata oil field in August.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to re-auction Mata oil field in August.

text.p: Venezuela's Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will re-auction the Mata marginal oil field operating contract in after a consortium of local companies was stripped of the field it won at auction in June, a top PDVSA official said.
"Yesterday the PDVSA board decided to declare the auction for the Mata field void," PDVSA vice President Claus Graf told reporters.
Graf said the Pivensa-PBE Trading Company consortium that won the field during the third auction round with a bid of $90.78 million, had failed to meet several contractual requirements.

The Mata field, which currently produces 600 barrels per day and has proven reserves of 101 million barrels, would be re- auctioned to all the companies that had qualified to bid in the third auction round, Graf said.
"The process will start from scratch," Graf said.
PDVSA received bids of more than $2.1 billion for the operating contracts in 18 fields.

Energy and Mines vice Minister Evanan Romero later explained that the Pivensa-PBE Trading consortium had been disqualified after another Venezuelan company bought out 75 percent of PBE Trading shares without informing PDVSA.
